item.title: Studio 8: A Disco Burlesque Experience
item.description:
When: Friday, August 21, 2026 · 8pm – 11pm

Where: Gallery5, 200 West Marshall Street, Richmond, VA 23220

A one-night-only disco burlesque revue presented by Onyx & 8th, blending classic burlesque, disco-era showgirl glamour, and immersive nightlife performance. Doors at 8pm, show at 9pm, 18+ only.
